nodes.label: One Validate-Persist-Project Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Agent writes and Manage rewrites share one pipeline because two write paths would diverge truth from projection silently.

nodes.label: Distillation Is a Projection of Raw
nodes.rationale: Raw sessions and provenance append once and stay; watermarks advance only past settled batches, so a missed trigger costs latency, never knowledge.

nodes.label: Shared Distillation Trigger Meaning
nodes.rationale: Forcing a boundary, crossing counts, idling or an explicit redistill all settle the same backlog: distill what the archive holds past the last mark; malformed replies leave it unsettled for retry.
